# pizzasim_pizza (Resource)

Pizza resource for managing pizza simulation pizzas.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Basic pizza resource
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "margherita" {
  name        = "Margherita"
  ingredients = ["tomato sauce", "mozzarella", "basil"]
  price       = 12.99
  description = "Classic Italian pizza"
}

# Pizza with custom description
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "pepperoni" {
  name        = "Pepperoni"
  ingredients = ["tomato sauce", "mozzarella", "pepperoni"]
  price       = 14.99
}

# Gourmet pizza with many ingredients
resource "pizzasim_pizza" "quattro_formaggi" {
  name = "Quattro Formaggi"
  ingredients = [
    "tomato sauce",
    "mozzarella",
    "gorgonzola",
    "parmesan",
    "ricotta"
  ]
  price       = 16.99
  description = "Four cheese pizza"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ingredients` (Set of String) List of ingredients on the pizza.
- `name` (String) Name of the pizza.
- `price` (Number) Price of the pizza.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the pizza.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Example identifier
- `last_baked` (String) Timestamp of when the pizza was last baked.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Import a pizza by name
terraform import pizzasim_pizza.margherita "Margherita"

# Import another pizza
terraform import pizzasim_pizza.pepperoni "Pepperoni"
```
